inverse-trig-restrict.alt: Cosine restricted to [0, pi], falling from (0, 1) to (pi, -1), and its reflection across the line y = x, the graph of inverse cosine, falling from (-1, pi) to (1, 0).

inverse-trig-sine-piece.alt: Graph of y = sin x from about negative pi to 2 pi in gray, with the piece from negative pi over 2 to pi over 2 drawn in heavy green, rising from (negative pi over 2, -1) to (pi over 2, 1). A dashed horizontal line at height one half crosses the sine curve at pi over 6 and again at 5 pi over 6.

inverse-trig-arctan.alt: Graph of y = inverse tangent of x for x from -6 to 6. The curve rises through (0, 0) and (1, pi over 4) and levels off between two dashed horizontal asymptotes, y = pi over 2 above and y = negative pi over 2 below.
